name: @harness/desktop
description: Tauri 2 window for Harness. It starts the supervisor and stops it on quit.

scripts.dev:hot: tauri dev --config '{"build":{"beforeDevCommand":"bash -c \"d=$PWD; while [ $d != / ] && [ ! -f $d/packages/supervisor/src/main.ts ]; do d=$(dirname $d); done; exec npm --prefix $d --workspace @harness/ui run dev\""}}'
